tickets.title: PDP Presentation Slides
tickets.description:
Grading Criteria:
Was the quality of text/figures/photos/equations good? Were the presenters enthusiastic and interesting? Did they speak clearly and to the audience?

To get 100%:
Polished, professional, and highly engaging. Presenters are persuasive and confident, handling questions with poise. Visual aids (slides, figures) are exceptional and significantly enhance understanding.

tickets.title: Introduction & Need Identification
tickets.description:
The introduction should provide the background and motivation for the project and a needs statement/assessment.
Make the audience aware of the pain that is being addressed and articulate it into a clear and well-defined need.
